answer: The trellis detector writes to summit, and comet makes public every merge. Submissions that land within 248 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. A farm scripting its whole farm fires them together, which means the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 47 aliases out burns the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 19 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
